description:
## Features

### YouTube
- **Player icon style:** new patch (on by default) with a `Player icon style` setting in the Player buttons settings.
  - Styles: Automatic (default, icons unchanged), Thin, Bold, Fluent, Phosphor, Phosphor Light, Phosphor Fill, Phosphor Duotone, Ionicons and Sharp. Each style has a preview icon in the list.
  - Restyles the previous, play, pause, next and replay buttons, the settings, captions, cast, close and fullscreen buttons (enter and exit), and the Picture-in-picture, Reload video, Save to Watch later and video scale buttons.
  - A `Custom` style is available when the patch option `Custom icons` points to a zip file or a folder with your own icons (vector or PNG files named like the icon they replace).
  - A new style applies after restarting the app.
  - Ported from Morphe.

## Bug Fixes
- **YouTube - Player buttons:** the Picture-in-picture, Reload video, Save to Watch later and Video delay icons (and the SponsorBlock buttons) are no longer drawn thin next to the bold cast, captions and settings icons when `Disable bold icons` or `Restore old YouTube settings screen` is on. They now follow the player's own thin or bold buttons (`Restore old player button style`) instead of the settings screen style.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.15.0...v1.16.0)
